title: DG8 - Closure
claim: A derivation cannot deny a capability whose use is required to formulate the denial.
definitions: Closure: the modal condition blocking claims that deny their own required capabilities.
negative_guards: Do not call closure a proof of theology.
Do not confuse closure with self-reference paradox.
kill_conditions: A self-defeating denial is admitted as valid inside the grammar.
RequiresToFormulate cannot be stated without making closure circular.
